DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知をお持ちですね。どの部分が分からずにいらっしゃいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You've brought a notice. Which part were you unable to understand?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 上の日付を見て、返事の期限が過ぎたと思いました。でも、日付の横には発行と書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大きな日付を期限と思ったが発行と記載されていると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I saw the date at the top and thought the reply deadline had passed. But next to that date it says issued.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you thought the prominent date was the deadline, but it is labeled as the issue date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 発行の日付と対応の期限は分けて確認しましょう。下の案内欄もご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the issue date separately from the response deadline. Have you looked at the instructions below too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 文字が多くて、まだ読めていません。返信が必要かと、必要なら期限がどこかを確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未読の案内欄を示し返信が必要か期限はどこか確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is a lot of text, so I haven't read it yet. I want to check whether a reply is needed and, if so, where the deadline is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point to the unread instructions and say you want to know whether a reply is needed and where its deadline is. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通知の担当に内容を尋ねましょう。連絡先が書かれた欄は見つかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's ask the staff responsible for the notice about its contents. Can you find the contact details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この欄に担当名と電話番号があります。表の大きな日付ではなく、案内と一緒に担当へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 担当名と電話を見つけ案内を見ながら問合せると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: This section has the staff's name and telephone number. I'll ask them while looking at the instructions, rather than relying on the large date on the front.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you found the staff name and phone number and will inquire while consulting the instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 用件を整理して連絡できますね。封筒の中にはほかの紙もありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can organize your questions before contacting them. Were there other papers in the envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 小さい返信用の紙がありました。不要だと思って別に置いたので、通知と合わせて持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別にした返信用紙を通知と合わせて持参すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: There was a small reply slip. I thought it unnecessary and set it aside, so I'll bring it together with the notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will bring the reply slip you separated together with the notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 同封物も含めて確認しましょう。担当への質問は、どのように伝えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's check the enclosures too. How will you explain your questions to the staff?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 発行日を期限と読み違えたことを説明し、返信の要否、期限、提出方法の順に尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発行日との誤解を説明して返信要否と期限と方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll explain that I mistook the issue date for the deadline, then ask whether a reply is required, its deadline, and how to submit it, in that order.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain the issue-date misunderstanding and ask about the need to reply, the deadline and the method. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、通知と同封の紙をそろえてご相談ください。読み取れない点は遠慮なくお伝えください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then gather the notice and enclosed papers for the consultation. Don't hesitate to mention anything you cannot understand. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの受診は初めてですね。今日はどのようなことで来られましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is your first visit here. What brings you in today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日から手首に痛みがあります。受付でどこまで説明するか分からず、症状をメモしてきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日から手首痛があり受付説明のためメモを用意したと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My wrist has hurt since yesterday. I wasn't sure how much to explain at reception, so I wrote notes about the symptoms.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you have had wrist pain since yesterday and prepared notes to explain it at reception. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: メモをお見せください。昨日のいつごろ気づいたか、覚えている範囲で教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Show me your note. As far as you remember, can you tell me when yesterday you noticed it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 夕方に鞄を持ったとき気づきました。それより前に始まったかは分からないので、気づいた時刻として書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 夕方に鞄を持ち痛みを感じたが以前の発症は不明と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I noticed it in the evening when I picked up my bag. I don't know whether it started earlier, so I'll write that as the time I noticed it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you felt pain when carrying your bag in the evening, but do not know whether it began earlier. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かる範囲をそのまま伝えてください。普段使っている薬について、分かるものはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tell us just what you know. Do you have anything identifying medication you regularly use?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 薬の名前を覚えていませんが、手元に記録があります。自己判断で名前を言わず、この記録を見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 名前を記憶で言わず所持する薬の記録を見せると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I don't remember the names, but I have a record with me. I won't guess the names; I'll show this record.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will show your medication record rather than name medicines from memory. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記録を確認できるようにしておきましょう。受付の案内で、まだ分からない点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Keep the record ready to check. Is there anything else about the reception instructions you don't understand?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 初めてなので、必要な持ち物の確認と、問診を書く場所を教えてください。メモは手元に置いて書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持ち物確認と問診を書く場所を聞きメモを参照して書きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's my first visit, so please check what I need to bring and tell me where to fill in the medical questionnaire. I'd like to keep my notes with me while writing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to check required items and where to fill in the questionnaire, and say you want to refer to your notes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付の案内を一緒に確認します。説明中に聞き取れなかった場合は、その場で聞き返してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check the reception guidance together. If you miss anything during the explanation, please ask again immediately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分からない言葉は確認します。痛みに気づいた時刻と薬の記録を混ぜずに、順番に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不明語を尋ね症状時刻と薬記録を分けて順に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask about words I don't understand. I'll explain when I noticed the pain and my medication record in order, keeping them separate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask about unfamiliar words and explain the symptom time and medication record separately in order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、受付の確認から進めましょう。メモと記録をお忘れなく、受診後のお帰りもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's start with the reception checks. Don't forget your notes and record, and take care on your way home after the visit too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 拾った物をお持ちですね。どこで見つけましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You've brought something you found. Where did you find it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: バス停近くのベンチにあった小さなケースです。イヤホンのケースに見えますが、開けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: バス停近くでケースを拾いイヤホン用らしいが開けていないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's a small case from a bench near the bus stop. It looks like an earphone case, but I haven't opened it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you found a case near the bus stop which looks like an earphone case, but you have not opened it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見た状態のままで教えてください。見つけた時刻は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tell us exactly what you saw. Do you know what time you found it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 午後二時ごろです。ベンチで休もうとして、座る場所の端に置かれているのを見つけました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二時ごろ休むためベンチ端のケースに気づいたと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Around two in the afternoon. I was about to rest on the bench when I found it at the edge of the seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that around two, when going to rest, you noticed the case at the bench's edge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見つけた後、近くの方に持ち主か尋ねましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: After finding it, did you ask anyone nearby whether it was theirs?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 隣にいた方に尋ねましたが、自分の物ではないと言われました。その方の物だとは決めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 隣の人は自分の物ではないと答えたため持ち主と断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I asked the person beside me, but they said it wasn't theirs. I'm not assuming it belonged to them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: The person nearby said it was not theirs, so do not identify them as the owner. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。ベンチの位置を説明できる目印はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Is there a landmark to explain where the bench is?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: バス停の看板の裏側にあり、近くに青いごみ箱があります。地図で場所を指せると思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 看板裏と青いごみ箱を目印に地図でベンチ位置を指す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's behind the bus stop sign, with a blue bin nearby. I think I can point it out on a map.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Use the back of the sign and blue bin as landmarks to indicate the bench on the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 地図で確認しましょう。ケースの外側で気づいた特徴もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's check the map. Did you notice any features on the case's exterior?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 白いケースで、ふたに小さい星のシールがあります。中に何が入っているかは確認せず、そのまま渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 白色と星シールを説明し中身を調べず現状のまま届ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: It's white, with a small star sticker on the lid. I haven't checked what's inside and will hand it in as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe the white color and star sticker, and hand it in unchanged without checking the contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 場所と特徴を伺いました。こちらで受付の確認を進めます。お届けいただきありがとうございます。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've heard the location and features. We'll proceed with the receiving checks here. Thank you for bringing it in. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居後の郵便についてですね。どのような確認をされたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about mail after moving. What would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: こちらで手続きすれば、郵便を送る相手に新住所を知らせなくてもよいと思っていました。そう理解してよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 郵便手続きだけで差出人へ新住所連絡は不要と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought completing the procedure here meant I wouldn't need to tell senders my new address. Is that understanding correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought postal procedures alone meant you need not tell senders your new address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 郵便の手続きと、相手が持つ住所の更新は分けて考えましょう。手続き自体はもう申し込みましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Consider postal procedures separately from updating the address held by the other party. Have you already applied for the procedure?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。旧住所と新住所を書いたメモがありますが、申込みの方法を先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未申込みで旧新住所メモがあり方法を先に聞きたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I have notes of the old and new addresses, but I'd like to ask how to apply first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have not applied, have old and new address notes, and want to ask the method first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付の方法と必要な確認を担当に尋ねます。新住所には建物名や部屋番号もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll ask the staff about the application method and necessary checks. Does the new address also have a building name and room number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: あります。番地だけのメモでは不十分かもしれないので、建物名と部屋番号も正しく書き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 番地に加え建物名と部屋番号を正しく書き直すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. A note with only the street number may be insufficient, so I'll rewrite it correctly with the building name and room number too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will correctly rewrite the building name and room number as well as the street address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記載を確かめておきましょう。定期的に郵便を送る相手には連絡できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check the details. Can you contact the people who regularly send you mail?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社と習い事の教室に知らせます。こちらの手続きを頼んだだけで、相手の登録も変わるとは考えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社と教室へ知らせ郵便手続きだけで相手登録は変わらないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll tell my company and the class I attend. I won't assume that asking for this postal procedure also changes their registered address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will tell your company and class, and confirm that postal procedures alone do not change their records. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 手続きを相談するときは、対象や期間も確認してください。今いちばん確認したい点は何ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: When discussing the procedure, check its scope and duration too. What do you most want to check now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 届くものすべてが同じ扱いとは決めず、手続きの対象と期間を聞き、差出人への連絡も別に進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: すべて同じ扱いと思わず対象期間を聞き差出人連絡も別に進める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't assume all incoming items are treated the same. I'll ask the scope and duration and separately contact the senders too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not assume all items are handled identically; ask about scope and duration and contact senders separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、住所のメモから確認しましょう。新生活の準備が整うとよいですね。お帰りもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's start with your address note. I hope preparations for your new life go well. Take care on your way home too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 登録情報の変更ですね。今回変わったのはどの部分でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want to update registered information. Which part has changed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 引っ越して住所が変わりました。連絡先の欄を全部書き直すつもりでしたが、電話番号は同じです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住所は変わったが電話番号は同じで全部書換えではないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My address changed after moving. I was going to rewrite all the contact fields, but my phone number is unchanged.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the address changed but the phone number is the same, so not everything needs rewriting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 変更する情報と、変わらない情報を分けて確認しましょう。住所のメモはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's distinguish changed information from unchanged information. Do you have a note of the address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 新住所のメモがあります。旧住所は記録を見ないと正確に書けないので、分からないまま埋めないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新住所メモはあり旧住所は記録が必要で推測記入しないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have my new address noted. I need to check records to write the old one accurately, so I won't fill it in while unsure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have a new-address note, need records for the old one, and won't guess when filling it in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当に記入の方法を聞いてください。銀行からの通知の送付先も気になっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ask the staff how to fill it in. Are you also concerned about where bank notices will be sent?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。新住所へ送ってほしいです。住所変更の申込みと通知の送付先の扱いを一緒に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新住所への通知を希望し住所申込みとの関係を確認したいと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'd like them sent to the new address. I want to check both the address-change application and how the mailing address for notices is handled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request notices at the new address and ask how this relates to the address-change application. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その希望を担当へ伝えます。今回、ほかの契約についても変更を頼むつもりでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll tell the staff your preference. Are you also intending to ask for changes to other contracts this time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 別の会社の契約もありますが、ここでまとめて変わるとは思っていません。それぞれの連絡先を分けて控えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他契約は銀行で変わらず会社別の連絡先を控えると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have contracts with other companies too, but I don't expect them all to change here. I'll record each company's contact details separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that other contracts will not change at the bank and you will note each company's contact details separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 銀行の登録について、完了の確認方法も尋ねてください。ご自身では何をメモされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ask how to confirm the bank's update is complete too. What will you note yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 変更する住所、同じ電話番号、通知の希望を別々に書きます。受付しただけで完了と決めず、確認方法も聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住所と不変の電話と通知希望を分け受付後の完了確認方法も聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll separately write the address to change, the unchanged phone number and my preference for notices. I won't assume receipt of the application means completion; I'll ask how to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate the address, unchanged phone and notice preference, and ask how to confirm completion after submission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、変更内容のメモを担当へお見せください。書類をお忘れなく、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then show the staff your notes on the changes. Don't forget your documents, and take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 瓶の表示を見比べていますか。どちらの品をお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you comparing the labels on the jars? Which are you considering?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一人で使うので迷っています。大瓶が割安に見えますが、開けた後も棚で保存してよいか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一人利用で大瓶が割安でも開封後に棚保存できるか確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm unsure because I'll use it alone. The large jar looks better value, but I want to know whether I can keep it on a shelf after opening too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that although the large jar looks economical for one person, you want to check shelf storage after opening. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 未開封の表示と、開封後の表示を分けて見ましょう。瓶の横にも記載があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Check the unopened and after-opening instructions separately. There is writing on the side too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここに開封後の案内がありました。正面だけ見て決めず、読めない部分を教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 正面だけで決めず横の開封後案内の読めない部分を教えてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I found the after-opening instructions here. Rather than deciding from the front alone, could you explain the part I can't read?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Do not decide from the front alone; ask about the unreadable part of the after-opening side label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示を一緒に読みます。ご自宅では、どのくらいの量を使う予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's read it together. How much do you plan to use at home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 週に一度少し使う程度です。表示に合う置き場所と、使い切れる量を考えると小瓶のほうがよいかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 週一回少量で保存場所と使切る量から小瓶を検討すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Just a little once a week. Considering a storage place matching the label and an amount I can finish, a small jar may be better.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you use a little weekly and are considering a small jar based on storage and an amount you can finish. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 使う量で選べますね。原材料についても確認したい項目はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can choose by the amount you use. Is there anything you also want to check about the ingredients?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この二つは同じ材料だと思っていました。似た名前でも原材料が同じとは限らないので、一覧を比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 似た商品名でも同材料と決めず二品の原材料を比べたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I thought these two used the same ingredients. Similar names don't guarantee that, so I'd like to compare the lists.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that similar product names do not necessarily mean the same ingredients, and you want to compare both lists. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それぞれのラベルで比較しましょう。価格だけで決めずに選べますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's compare each label. You can choose based on more than price.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 原材料と開封後の表示を確認し、自分の使う量に合う小瓶を選びます。保存する場所も表示に合わせて準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 材料と開封後表示を確認し少量利用の小瓶を選び保存場所を準備する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the ingredients and after-opening instructions, then choose a small jar matching my usage. I'll also prepare a storage place according to the label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check ingredients and after-opening instructions, choose a small jar for your limited use, and prepare storage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、こちらの表示から見ていきましょう。お声かけありがとうございました。よいお買い物を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's start with this label. Thank you for asking. Enjoy your shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 遠くの休憩所へ向かわれますか。雨の後なので、道の様子も見ていってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you going to the rest area farther away? It has rained, so check the paths as you go too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: そこまで歩くつもりでしたが、靴が土の道に向いていません。舗装された道で短く歩きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 土向きでない靴のため遠い休憩所より舗装の短い経路を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I intended to walk there, but my shoes aren't suited to dirt paths. I'd like a short walk on a paved path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that your shoes are unsuitable for dirt, so you prefer a short paved route to the distant rest area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 図で舗装の表示を確認しましょう。行きたい休憩所まで全部同じ道とは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the paving symbols on the map. The path may not be the same all the way to that rest area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 途中で土の道に変わるのですね。遠い休憩所はやめて、舗装の続く近くの場所を探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 途中が土道と分かり遠い休憩所をやめ舗装の近い場所を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it turns into dirt along the way. I'll give up the distant rest area and look for somewhere nearby with continuous paving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that learning the route becomes dirt, you will give up the distant rest area and look nearby on paving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 近くの休憩地点も見てみましょう。座る場所を選ぶとき、どんな点を確認しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's look at nearby resting points too. What will you check when choosing a seat?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 雨でぬれていないか見ます。座れなければ、さらに遠くを探すより入口へ戻って休みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 座面のぬれを見て座れなければ遠くを探さず入口へ戻る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll check whether it's wet from the rain. If I can't sit, I'll return to the entrance to rest instead of searching farther away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether the seat is wet and return to the entrance if you cannot sit, rather than searching farther. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 戻る道を先に覚えておくとよいですね。今いる場所から入口の方向をたどれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: It's good to remember the return route first. Can you trace the direction of the entrance from here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 図のこの線ですね。舗装が続く範囲で往復し、細い土の道を近道に使わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 地図線で入口方向を示し舗装の範囲を往復して土の近道を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: This line on the map, right? I'll go and return within the paved sections and won't use a narrow dirt shortcut.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Point out the entrance direction along the map line, make a return trip within paving, and avoid dirt shortcuts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 散歩の距離を無理なく変えられますね。予定を伝えている方はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can adjust your walk without overdoing it. Have you told anyone your plans?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族に遠い休憩所へ行くと言いました。近い場所までの往復に変更したと知らせ、道の様子を見ながら戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 遠い休憩所から近い場所往復へ変更したと連絡し道を見て戻る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I told my family I was going to the distant rest area. I'll tell them I've changed to a nearby return walk and come back while checking the path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell them you changed from the distant rest area to a nearby return walk, and check the path as you return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、足元を見てゆっくりお進みください。短い散歩を楽しんで、帰りもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40229-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then watch your footing and go slowly. Enjoy a short walk and take care on the way back too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ベビーカーでの移動でしたら、改札を通る前に経路を確かめましょう。目指すホームはおわかりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: With a stroller, let's check the route before going through the ticket gates. Do you know which platform you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二番のホームです。入口の横に昇降機が見えたので、そこで上がればよいと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 見える昇降機をホーム行きだと思ったと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Platform two. I saw an elevator beside the entrance, so I think I should go up there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Indicate that you thought the visible elevator led to the platform. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その昇降機は、図では駅前の通路につながっています。ホームへの昇降機とは別ですので、改札を通った先を見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The map shows that elevator connecting to the passage in front of the station. It's separate from the platform elevator, so let's look beyond the gates.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 見える物が全部ホーム行きではないのですね。改札の外で上がる前に聞いてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 駅前通路への昇降機を乗車経路と取り違えない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So not every visible elevator goes to the platforms. I'm glad I asked before going up outside the gates.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Do not confuse the elevator to the station-front passage with your boarding route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの図で、二番への経路とベビーカーが通れる改札の案内を確かめましょう。乗車までの時間はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: On this map, let's check the route to platform two and the gate suitable for strollers. Do you have time before boarding?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 発車までまだ余裕があります。子どももいるので、最短の道より、落ち着いて通れる経路を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 速さより落ち着いて通れる経路を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: There's still plenty of time before departure. I have my child, so I'd rather know a calm route than the shortest one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request a route you can use calmly rather than prioritizing speed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 図では右側の通路から昇降機へ向かいます。利用の状況は現地の表示で確認し、止まっていたら係員へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The map shows a right-hand passage to the elevator. Check local signs for its operating status; if it is stopped, ask staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 右側へ進んで表示を見ます。使えないときは、ベビーカーを持って階段へ行く前に、別の方法を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ベビーカーで階段を進む前に代案を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll go right and check the signs. If it can't be used, I'll ask about alternatives before carrying the stroller toward the stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for an alternative before taking the stroller toward the stairs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、無理に運ばずお声かけください。ホームに着いたら、列車の行き先も確認してからお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, don't force yourself to carry it; ask us. Once on the platform, check the train destination before waiting too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 改札内の昇降機で二番へ行き、行き先の表示を確かめます。入口で見えた物と取り違えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 改札内の設備と列車の行き先を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll use the elevator inside the gates to reach platform two and check the destination display. I won't confuse it with the one I saw at the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the facilities inside the gates and the train's destination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ホームへ向かう順序がわかりましたね。お子さんとゆっくりお進みになり、どうぞお気をつけてご乗車ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Now you know the order for reaching the platform. Proceed slowly with your child, and board safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転入について確認されたいとのことですね。受付の画面などをお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want to check moving-in procedures. Do you have an application screen or similar record?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 前の市へ送った画面があります。完了と書かれているので、こちらでも住所の手続きが済んだのか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: オンライン送信で当地も済んだか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have the screen I sent to my previous city. It says complete, so I want to know whether the address procedure here is also finished.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether the online submission also completed procedures here. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その完了が何の手続きか、画面の件名と送信先を確認しましょう。表示だけで、転入まで済んだとは判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the screen's subject and recipient to see what was completed. That display alone doesn't prove moving-in procedures are done.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 件名は前の市での手続きで、送信先も前の市です。新しい住所を書いたので、こちらへも届いたと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新住所を書いたことと転入完了を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The subject concerns the previous city and the recipient is that city too. Because I wrote the new address, I thought it reached here too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish writing the new address from completing moving-in procedures. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付の状況を担当窓口で確認してください。こちらへ相談に来るのは、ご本人だけでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Check the application status at the responsible counter. Is only yourself coming to consult here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今回は私だけ引っ越しました。家族は前の住所に残っています。画面の申込者も私の名前です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 旧住所に残る家族の分と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Only I moved this time. My family remains at the old address. The applicant on the screen is my name too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish your procedures from those of family remaining at the old address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その状況を伝えると確認しやすいですね。本人確認に使うものや新しい住所の資料も、お持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Explaining that makes it easier to check. Do you also have identification and materials showing the new address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 在留カードと、部屋の住所がわかる契約書を持っています。画面の写真だけで足りるとは思わず、資料も見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 画面写真だけで必要資料が足りると決めない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have my residence card and a contract showing my room's address. I don't assume a screen photo is enough; I'd like the materials checked too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not assume a screen photo alone meets the document requirements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な資料や記入は、担当者の案内に合わせて進めましょう。健康保険など、関連して不明なことも先に挙げておけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Follow the staff's guidance on necessary documents and forms. You can also mention related uncertainties, such as health insurance, in advance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 会社の保険について確認中なので、その状況も話します。前の市の受付と、こちらで残る手続きを分けて教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 前自治体の受付後に当地で行うことを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'm checking my workplace insurance, so I'll explain that too. Please tell me separately about the previous city's acceptance and the procedures still needed here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check what needs to be done here after the previous municipality accepted the application. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 画面の意味と今回の状況が整理できましたね。資料をお持ちになって担当へ進み、案内を確かめてからお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've clarified the screen's meaning and your situation. Take your materials to the responsible staff and check their guidance before leaving.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約票を持って相談に戻られたのですね。日時のことで食い違いがありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You've returned with your appointment slip to consult. Was there a mismatch concerning the date or time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この上の日付で仕事の休みを取ったのですが、下にも別の日があります。どちらが受診の予約でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕事を休んだ日と受診予定の違いを確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I took time off work for the date at the top, but there's another date below. Which is the actual appointment?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check the difference between the day you took off work and the appointment date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この票では、上は印刷した日で、予約日時は下の枠です。枠にある日と時刻を読んでみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this slip, the top is the printing date; the appointment is in the box below. Please read the date and time in that box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 下の枠は来週の木曜の午前です。その日は仕事があります。予約日だと思って、印刷した日に休みを取ってしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 印刷日を受診予定にした誤りを訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The lower box says next Thursday morning. I work that day. I mistook the printing date for the appointment and took leave then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct the mistake of taking the printing date as the appointment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 行き違いがわかりましたね。予約担当へ変更の相談をしましょう。来られる候補は、もう確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Now we know the misunderstanding. Let's discuss a change with appointment staff. Have you already checked alternative times you can come?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 金曜の午後なら来られます。ほかの日は勤務先に聞いてからでないと返事ができません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: すぐ返答できる変更希望を限定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can come Friday afternoon. I can't answer about other days until I've checked with work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Limit your change request to alternatives you can confirm immediately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 第一希望と未確認の候補を担当者に伝えてください。体調が変わったことなど、日時以外に知らせたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tell the staff your first choice and which alternatives are unconfirmed. Is there anything apart from the time, such as a health change, you want to mention?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 前回から特に変わっていません。日時を変えるだけでよいかは、担当の方に確認してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 日時以外の相談が必要か担当へ委ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Nothing has particularly changed since last time. I'd like the staff to check whether changing only the appointment is sufficient.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Leave it to the responsible staff to check whether consultation beyond the time change is needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その希望をお伝えください。新しい枠が取れるかは担当者の確認が必要ですので、まだ変更が決まったとは考えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell them that. Staff must confirm whether a new slot is available, so don't assume the change has already been made.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 返答が来るまで新しい予定は確定させません。変更できたら、予約日時の枠を読んで勤務先にも伝え直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当の返答前に変更済みと思わない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't finalize new plans until the reply arrives. If I can change it, I'll read the appointment box and inform my workplace again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not assume the appointment is changed before the staff reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 次は日付の見方も確かめられそうですね。予約票を忘れずに担当へご相談ください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40230-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Next time you'll also be able to check how to read the dates. Don't forget your slip when consulting appointment staff. Take care of yourself.
